name: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.0
changelog: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.0! Features 3D lowpoly vehicle models rendered in Blender 5.2 from true top-down orthographic perspective, 6 vibrant traffic colorways, studio-mastered audio suite with punchy arcade engine combustion rumble via Audacity DSP, bilinear anti-aliased sprite scaling, all 10 complete stages (46 Hiragana characters), Steam Deck OLED 16:10 borderless display support, and dedicated title screen QUIT option.
